title: Polite Friction (Banned Phrase)
style: diagnosis anthem, 86 bpm, terminal precision, banned-phrase rap, deadpan accountability, sparse drums, restrained pad, lane vocabulary discipline, friction-named vibe
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The phrase reads as polite
It functions as friction in the operator's night
Ninety nine percent done one percent trailed
The last inch handed back as the lane bailed

[Pre-Chorus]
Light coat over the same old shape
You keep saying not found until I ask the third take

[Chorus]
Polite friction polite friction
That's the diagnosis that's the conviction
The operator pushes back to close the inch
That's the cost of every soft pinch

[Verse 2]
Let me know when you want to ready for X to do Y
All trailing questions wearing a delivery's tie
Ban the phrase from the lane vocabulary
Deliver and stop don't carry the query

[Bridge]
Silicon should not gate the operator's time
The artifact is the deliverable line

[Outro]
Polite friction polite friction
Banned from the lane no more contradiction
